Messages.Author: John Alston Campbell
Messages.Body:
If I use Acrobatics at superior to dodge can I then use blur at superior for
two additional strikes instead of one?

John

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>If I use Acrobatics at superior to dodge can I then use blur at superior for
>two additional strikes instead of one?

No. Barring specific card text (i.e. superior Quickness and Jacko), each round
you can only gain additional strikes from one source. Playing Acrobatics at
superior gives you an additional strike, so you can not gain even more
additional strikes from other sources (barring those special exceptions).

Halcyan 2
